recovery: deposits in every recovery state; the Recover / Sweep manually / Finalize flows run end to end against the fake wallet
activity: the full mixed feed: transfers, payment links, requests, deposits, bridge-ins, withdrawals
fresh: an onboarded wallet with an empty feed
empty: a zero-balance wallet with an empty feed
contacts: long L1 and L2 contacts with recorded activity
contact-search: local, registry and retryable add-contact states
onboarding: identity-free onboarding; combine with /claim?mock=create|claiming|deposit|deposit-expired|funded, plus &min=&fee= for the chain schedule, &token=DAI|USDC|USDT and &received= for a deposit already at the address
